notes.title: The Lobby Update!
notes.content:
Hey gamers, it has been a long wait to get the new lobby out there, but it is finally here! There will be some bug fixes throughout the next couple weeks to polish things up, but the new free roam lobby and character selection are both fully operational with nearly 40 skins to choose from!

changes:
* the lobby has been upgraded to a free roam level where you can run around, shoot at your friends, practice some gamemodes, and customize your character
* a character customization booth has been added to the lobby that allows you change your character (in some cases to alternate skins) and the colour of your outlines
* additions of various visual effects for modifiers
* new gameplay songs
* adjustments to knockback to make it both more notaicible and counter-playable
* credit updates, including galleries of fan-art contest winners that have been added to the game


We have at least a couple more updates planned for the game coming up in the next month or two, so stay tuned for that! 

Derf you later,
The Derf team
